label: GitHub Pull Request
description: A pull request in a repository the GitHub connector syncs: a read-only task whose title, body and status come from GitHub. Its status is draft or open while the pull request is open, merged once merged, and closed when closed without merging.

github_id.description: The pull request's GitHub node id.

number.description: The pull request's number in its repository.

repository.description: The repository's full name, as owner/name.

private.description: Whether the repository this row is in is private on GitHub, as of the last read.

author.description: The GitHub login that opened the pull request.

status.description: The pull request's state on GitHub: draft or open while it is open, merged when merged, and closed when closed without merging.

merged_at.description: When the pull request was merged, if it was.

base_branch.description: The branch the pull request targets.

head_branch.description: The branch the pull request comes from.

checks.description: A summary of the checks on the pull request's head commit: the rollup state, non-zero check run counts by state (check_runs), and non-zero commit status counts by state (statuses). Null when the commit has no checks. When GitHub refuses the token the checks, the summary read last is kept, and a pull request first read then has none.

github_updated_at.description: When GitHub last changed the pull request.

check_runs.label: Check runs
check_runs.description: Each check run and commit status on the pull request's head commit, as GitHub reported them at the last read. A row's id comes from GitHub's own id for the check, so a check read again is the same row. Empty when GitHub refuses the token the checks.

name.description: The check run's name, or the status context's name.

kind.description: Whether this is a check run or a commit status.

status.description: A check run's state (such as QUEUED, IN_PROGRESS or COMPLETED), or a commit status's state (such as PENDING or SUCCESS), as GitHub names it.

conclusion.description: How a completed check run ended (such as SUCCESS or FAILURE), as GitHub names it. Empty until it completes, and for a commit status.

url.description: Where GitHub shows the check's details.

started_at.description: When the check run started, or when the commit status was created.
